items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Steve Loicano went over to visit him... she gave him a cold shoulder.

ctx.x: He had left his wife and children, didn't he?

Yeah. I agree with that. He married another woman over in Pensacola, Florida, and Steve Loicano went over to visit him, and when the woman found out Steve was a musician, she gave him a cold shoulder. Didn't want him in the house. I guess Brown Lee had quit playing or something, maybe they had a fuss about playing. He's the president of the Pensacola local. Local, yeah. That's right, too. Because I played over there. Brown Lee? Yeah. Oh, that's right. Bill's smiling. Norman Brown. Norman Brown. Yeah, still…
with, what's his name? Bill Whitmore, poor guy died. Yeah, Bill Whitmore died.
